_comment: Every execution-looking work-state vocabulary in production code, classified (#36/#1136). The convergence program's central claim is that Run/NodeRun/Attempt is the one execution identity; a new enum, status-shaped Literal alias, or status-shaped Literal field whose members are work states is how a second one gets built, usually without anyone deciding to. scripts/check-execution-lifecycles.py detects all three shapes and ratchets against this file in both directions: an unclassified identity fails, and an entry whose identity no longer exists fails until pruned. CANONICAL = part of the spine. DOMAIN = a genuinely different lifecycle. PROJECTION and RECEIPT = non-authoritative views or admission records. CONVERGE = a competing work-state machine, with the issue that removes it. Free-text and database-column audits remain separate; services.dag_run_store and maistro_canvas.canvas.runner are recorded in docs/architecture/CONVERGENCE-MATRIX.md.

maistro.runs.model::RunStatus.rationale: The Run half of the canonical execution identity (ADR-081226-a66b).

maistro.runs.model::AttemptStatus.rationale: The Attempt half; one physical execution, chronological across retries.

maistro.capabilities.invocation::Invocat.rationale: The canonical Binding -> Invocation effect boundary (ADR-081226-6b46): one provider call beneath an Attempt, keyed by a retry-stable effect_key.

maistro.events.invocations::InvocationSt.rationale: Not the same thing as the Invocation above despite the identical class name: this is an event handler's at-most-once record per (trigger_id, event_id) under ADR-086, so replay retries the same row. The name collision is confusing and worth renaming, but the lifecycle is legitimately its own.

maistro.graph.phases::NodePhase.rationale: Graph traversal phase, which ADR-062 and #44 keep in GraphExecutionState precisely so traversal state stays separate from execution lifecycle. It must not become the authority for whether work succeeded -- that is NodeRun's.

maistro.graph.phases::GraphPhase.rationale: The whole-graph counterpart of NodePhase, same reasoning.

maistro.tasks.models::TaskStatus.rationale: The task queue's own work states. #41 makes submission yield a canonical run_id and demotes the queue to an admission receipt; the Run then owns terminal truth.

maistro.a2a.delegate::TaskStatus.rationale: Delegation's own queued/assigned/running/completed/failed ladder, driven by a worker pool. #47 makes delegation create child Runs with durable parent correlation.

maistro.builders.contracts::RunStatus.rationale: Builders' own RunStatus, consumed by builders.runtime and by the graph_executor that drives its own traversal. #49 moves Builders onto canonical Graph/Run.

maistro.builders.pipeline::StageStatus.rationale: Per-stage states for the issue-to-merge pipeline, driven by GraphPipelineExecutor. Becomes NodeRun state under #49.

maistro_canvas.types::JobStatus.rationale: Canvas generation job states, driven by canvas.runner's claim/lease/reap loop. #52 makes canvas stages canonical NodeRuns and retries Attempts.

maistro.graph.nodes.agent_delegate_remot.rationale: Delegation's Literal status ladder is a worker-owned execution debt, not canonical Run truth. #47 moves delegation onto child Runs with durable parent correlation.

services.rsi::RunStatus.rationale: RSI's Literal run status is a product-local execution ladder. #50 makes each improvement cycle a canonical Run over the authorized work source.

maistro.graph.nodes.agent_spawn_harness:.rationale: The node output reports a delegated harness result; canonical Run/NodeRun/Attempt state remains authoritative.

maistro.graph.nodes.base::NodeResult.sta.rationale: NodeResult is an output projection of a node execution, not an independent execution owner.

maistro.orchestrator.waves.types::WaveHa.rationale: WaveHandle carries a parallel branch execution ladder that must become Graph nodes and canonical NodeRuns under #44.

models.schemas::Container.status.rationale: Container health/availability state is product infrastructure domain state, not canonical Run terminal truth.

models.schemas::Mission.status.rationale: Mission progress is a Hive product-domain projection; canonical Run/NodeRun/Attempt state owns physical execution.

models.schemas::MissionStep.status.rationale: Mission-step progress is a Hive product-domain projection; it does not replace canonical Run/NodeRun/Attempt state.
